basic_details.job_title: SPA Admin cum Accounts Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The School of Planning and Architecture: New Delhi (योजना एवं वास्तुकला विद्यालय: नई दिल्ली) has one post of Admin cum Accounts Officer Contractual (Part Time) in a research project of its Department of Physical Planning, at a monthly salary of 16,538. Applications go by email to [email protected] and must be sent latest by 8 December 2026. The vacancy notice, Ref No.178/BPP/SPA/2026, is dated 23 November 2026.

important_dates.interview_date: To be informed by email to shortlisted candidates

content_sections.heading: About SPA New Delhi
content_sections.text: The School of Planning and Architecture: New Delhi is an institution in New Delhi. This vacancy is in its Department of Physical Planning, for the research project "Technical Capacity Building and Organizational Strengthening for Urban Planning Development with Focus on small towns In Uttar Pradesh". The notice is signed by Prof. Dr. Poonam Prakash, Professor and Team Lead, Department of Physical Planning.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application goes only by email. The notice asks interested candidates to send their updated CV along with relevant certificates and supporting documents to: Email address: [email protected] Deadline: latest by 8 December 2026 The notice does not prescribe an application form or an email subject line, and it gives no postal address for applications.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The single post is filled on a contractual, part-time basis for the research project named above, with New Delhi as the location. Post: Admin cum Accounts Officer Contractual (Part Time) Number of posts: 01 Monthly salary: 16,538 Educational qualification: Bachelor's Degree in B.COM or Master's Degree in M.COM/MBA from any recognised university. Experience: Having experience of 3-5 years in administration and accounts. Age limit: not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications received by email will be screened, and only shortlisted candidates will be informed about the interview schedule through email. The notice does not give an interview date or venue.
